Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL1134614. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return one row per compound record and sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
